name: Pyranthex-S3
description: An ultra-high-temperature ceramic composite based on hafnium diboride and zirconium carbide matrices reinforced with silicon carbide whiskers, capable of sustained operation at surface temperatures exceeding 3,000°C without structural degradation. The nano-assembled microstructure features deliberate thermal gradient channels that redirect heat flux away from structural load paths, preventing the catastrophic thermal shock failures that plagued earlier UHTC formulations. Pyranthex-S3 is the dominant material for atmospheric re-entry vehicle leading edges and industrial plasma containment.
story_hooks: A salvager finds intact Pyranthex-S3 tiles among wreckage from an unregistered re-entry vehicle — the tiles are worth a fortune, but whatever came down in that craft is drawing serious attention.
Someone has been stealing Pyranthex-S3 tiles from a re-entry vehicle maintenance bay in small quantities — not enough for a vehicle, but exactly enough for something else entirely.

A Tier 5 engineer claims the latest Pyranthex-S3 batch has a thermal gradient flaw that will cause catastrophic failure at peak re-entry — and the next scheduled descent carries three hundred passengers.
